Job Description

Narvar is growing! We are looking for Senior Fullstack Software Engineers that enjoy working on both APIs and UIs. In this role, you will build products that power the post-purchase experience for the biggest brands in the retail industry. As a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer, you will have a direct impact on our customer-facing products and work with modern technologies like Java, NodeJS, Python, React, and GraphQL to ship complex features that drive millions of views. &#xA;&#xA; For this role, you should be located in Canada and able to work within EST/EDT OR PST hours. We are fully remote. &#xA;&#xA; Day-to-day &#xA;&#xA; Frontend Development (Primary Focus) &#xA;&#xA; &#xA; Implement new product features & support/ extend existing ones &#xA; Build frontend platform components leveraged across our internal, external products and ecommerce storefronts like Shopify, Salesforce etc &#xA; Contribute to our overall architecture and maintain code quality standards by partnering with other senior engineers &#xA; Work with product and design teams to translate wireframes and mockups into functional UI components &#xA; &#xA;&#xA; Backend Development (Secondary Focus) &#xA;&#xA; &#xA; Contribute to development and maintenance of backend services using Golang, Node.js &#xA; Understanding of google cloud platform (GCP) , CI/CD and be able to deploy code and infrastructure components &#xA; Work with databases like postgres, spanner, bigquery &#xA; Understand and implement RESTful or GraphQL APIs &#xA; &#xA;&#xA; What we&rsquo;re looking for &#xA;&#xA; &#xA; You have a BS/MS in computer science, information systems, or equivalent &#xA; You have 10+ years of experience building reliable, scalable, and high-quality systems &#xA; Experience in building consumer facing applications with a frontend framework(s), such as React (preferable), Svelte Angular, Vue or Ember &#xA; Experience building well-designed software with NodeJS or Golang &#xA; Experience developing consumer facing applications consuming various APIs from a microservice backend system &#xA; Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus. &#xA; Knowledge of full development life cycle and computer science fundamentals &#xA; Strong focus on code quality and code reviews &#xA; Experience with mentoring other engineers &#xA; Previous startup experience strongly preferred with growth and product engineering mindset &#xA; &#xA;&#xA; Why Narvar? &#xA;&#xA; We&rsquo;re on a mission to simplify the everyday lives of consumers. Post-purchase is a critical phase of the customer journey. That&rsquo;s why we created Narvar - a platform focused on driving customer loyalty through seamless post-purchase experiences that allow retailers to retain, engage, and delight customers. If you&rsquo;ve ever bought something online, there&rsquo;s a good chance you&rsquo;ve used our platform! &#xA;&#xA; From the hottest new direct-to-consumer companies to retail’s most renowned brands, Narvar works with GameStop, Neiman Marcus, Sonos, Nike, and 1300+ other brands.
